cgv.art1Texte: These terms and conditions govern the sale of digital gift cards made on the Estalviar website. Any order implies unreserved acceptance of these terms.
cgv.art2Texte: Estalviar sells customizable digital gift cards from partner brands. Cards are delivered exclusively by electronic means.
cgv.art3Texte: Prices are shown in euros, all taxes included. Payment is made securely online.
cgv.art4Texte: The gift card is sent by email immediately after payment, unless the customer chose a delayed delivery date.
cgv.art5Texte: In accordance with Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal does not apply to gift cards once their code has been communicated to the customer.

confidentialite.intro: Estalviar attaches great importance to protecting your personal data.
confidentialite.donneesTexte: We collect your email, first/last name if provided, order history, and payment information handled by our payment provider.
confidentialite.finalitesTexte: Your data is used to process your orders, manage your account and loyalty program, and contact you if needed.
confidentialite.conservationTexte: Your data is kept for the duration necessary for the business relationship, then legally archived.
confidentialite.droitsTexte: In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and port your data. Contact info@estalviar.com.
confidentialite.partageTexte: Your data is never sold. It may be shared with our technical providers strictly as necessary.

fideliteAccueil.texte: With an Estalviar account, every euro you spend becomes a point. From €100, your purchases earn cashback to spend on your next cards.

faqAccueil.q1: How does the recipient use the card?
faqAccueil.r1: They receive an email with the card code and use it directly with the brand, online or in store depending on each brand's terms.
faqAccueil.q2: How long is the card valid?
faqAccueil.r2: Validity depends on each brand. A question about a specific brand? Write to us before buying and we'll answer quickly.
faqAccueil.q3: Can I choose the delivery date?
faqAccueil.r3: Yes. Pick the date and time when personalising the card: it arrives right on time, even months from now.
faqAccueil.q4: What if the email doesn't arrive?
faqAccueil.r4: First check the spam folder. Otherwise, write to info@estalviar.com with the address used for the order and we'll resend the card.
faqAccueil.proTitre: Are you a company or works council?
faqAccueil.proTexte: Gifts for your teams or clients: a single invoice, volume pricing, a quote within 48 hours.

retractation.intro: Changed your mind? Fill in this form to exercise your right of withdrawal on an order. You will immediately receive an acknowledgement of receipt by email.
retractation.exception: Withdrawal is possible for 14 days as long as the card has not been sent (a card scheduled for later, for example). Once the code has been sent, it is no longer possible, as accepted when ordering.
retractation.email: Email address used for the order
retractation.commandeExemple: E.g. €50 Fnac card for Léa, ordered on 12 October
retractation.verifierTexte: By confirming, you notify us that you withdraw from the order above.
retractation.erreur: Something went wrong. Write to us at info@estalviar.com.
retractation.merciEmail: An acknowledgement of receipt has just been sent to you by email. We will get back to you shortly.
retractation.merciSansEmail: Please note this reference: the acknowledgement email could not be sent, but your request has been recorded.

fidelitePage.intro: Every card you give earns you points. Points move you up the tiers, and from the Silver tier your orders earn cashback to spend on your next cards.
fidelitePage.max: You have reached the highest tier.
fidelitePage.ctaTexte: Create your account and sign up to the newsletter: 25 points straight away.
fidelitePage.dejaCompte: Already have an account? Log in
fidelitePage.gagner1Texte: Every euro paid on Estalviar. A €50 card = 50 points.
fidelitePage.gagner2Texte: Contributing to a group gift also earns you points.
fidelitePage.gagner3Texte: When you sign up to the newsletter, once per account.
fidelitePage.gagner4Texte: Your points are yours to keep and your tier never drops over time.
fidelitePage.paliersTexte: Your tier depends on your points. Each tier unlocks new brands and higher cashback.
fidelitePage.enseignes: {n, plural, =0 {} one {# more brand} other {# more brands}}
fidelitePage.etape1Texte: The order's cashback appears in your account as "pending".
fidelitePage.etape2Texte: It becomes available {j} days after the card is sent (for a scheduled card, {j} days after the chosen date).
fidelitePage.etape3Texte: At checkout, on an order of at least €{min}, up to {max}% of the amount.
fidelitePage.etape4Texte: Each cashback expires 12 months after being credited. We email you 30 days beforehand.
fidelitePage.exempleTexte: You have €15 of cashback available and order a €24 card. You can use up to €12 (50% of €24): you pay €12 and have €3 of cashback left.
fidelitePage.r1: It depends on your tier at the time of the order and on the brand chosen. Some brands, on which our margin is too low, do not earn cashback.
fidelitePage.q2: I pay part with my cashback: do I still earn?
fidelitePage.r2: You earn your points, but no new cashback on that order.
fidelitePage.r3: The code gives you its own cashback, which replaces your tier's cashback for that order (no combining). You still earn your points. A code cannot be used together with your cashback.
fidelitePage.r4: No: contributions earn points, but not cashback.
fidelitePage.q5: What happens if an order is refunded?
fidelitePage.r5: The points and cashback earned on the refunded order are removed.
fidelitePage.q6: Can cashback be paid into my bank account?
fidelitePage.r6: No: it is a credit usable only on Estalviar. It cannot be refunded or transferred to another account, and it is lost if you delete your account.
